newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hanwha Merchant FRCD raised to $30 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hanwha Merchant FRCD raised to $30 mln.

text.p: Hanwha Merchant Bank's floating rate certificates of deposit issue due 1997 has been increased to US$30 million from US$20 million, arranger Sumitomo Finance (Asia) said.
The certificates carry a maturity of 364 days from the deposit date. They were issued at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.

Arrangers and lead managers are Housing and Commercial Bank Korea Tokyo branch, ING Barings, KDB Asia, Sumitomo Finance (Asia), CIBC Asia, SBC Warburg, Societe Generale Asia and Union Bank of Switzerland Hong Kong branch.
Signing is set for December 4 in Hong Kong. The payment date is December 13.
